title: Broadcom, Apple extend chip supply deal through 2031
title_zh: 博通与苹果将芯片供应协议延长至 2031 年
summary: Broadcom said on Monday it has agreed to expand its partnership with ‌Apple through 2031 to develop and supply ‌a range of custom chips, sending the shares of the chipmaker ​up nearly 4% in premarket trading.
summary_zh: 博通周一表示，已同意将与苹果的合作关系扩大到 2031 年，以开发和供应一系列定制芯片，这使得该芯片制造商的股价在盘前交易中上涨了近 4%。

title: This surprising wrinkle in the 2026 bull market could drive stocks higher
title_zh: 2026 年牛市的这一令人惊讶的波动可能会推动股市走高
summary: The S&P 500's forward P/E ratio is now below where it started in 2026.
summary_zh: 标准普尔 500 指数的远期市盈率目前低于 2026 年开始的水平。

title: The Investors Scrambling to Keep SpaceX - and Elon Musk - Out of Their Portfolios
title_zh: 投资者争先恐后地将 SpaceX 和埃隆·马斯克排除在投资组合之外
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Christopher Bejnar has spent the last couple of months combing through the fine print of exchange-traded funds, emailing financial advisers and moving money into European stocks – all to keep SpaceX out of his $1 million portfolio.Most Read from BloombergOil, Ga...
summary_zh: （彭博社）——克里斯托弗·贝纳尔（Christopher Bejnar）在过去几个月里仔细研究了交易所交易基金的细则，向财务顾问发送电子邮件，并将资金转移到欧洲股票——所有这些都是为了将​​ SpaceX 排除在他 100 万美元的投资组合之外。

title: Morgan Stanley’s Wilson Sees Rotation From Chips to Hyperscalers
title_zh: 摩根士丹利的威尔逊认为从芯片到超大规模的转变
summary: (Bloomberg) -- US stocks will struggle to reach new highs as investors rotate out of some of this year’s biggest winning technology trades, according to Morgan Stanley strategists.Most Read from BloombergOil, Gas Tankers Cross Hormuz Via Oman-Side Route After U-TurnsGreece Off...

title: ITV and Sky reshape British TV landscape with $2.1 billion deal
title_zh: ITV 和 Sky 以 21 亿美元的交易重塑英国电视格局
summary: Comcast's Sky has agreed to buy the broadcast channels and streaming service of Britain's ITV for £1.6 billion ($2.13 billion), creating a British champion to compete with global players YouTube, Netflix, Amazon and Disney.
summary_zh: 康卡斯特旗下的天空电视台已同意以 16 亿英镑（合 21.3 亿美元）的价格收购英国独立电视台 (ITV) 的广播频道和流媒体服务，打造英国冠军品牌，与全球巨头 YouTube、Netflix、亚马逊和迪士尼竞争。

title: Stock market today: Nasdaq leads S&P 500, Dow futures higher as tech jitters ease, oil slips
title_zh: 今日股市：纳斯达克指数领先标准普尔 500 指数，道指期货走高，因科技股紧张情绪缓解，油价下跌
summary: Gains were concentrated in tech stocks after the Dow closed shy of 53,000.
summary_zh: 道指收盘低于 53,000 点后，涨幅主要集中在科技股。

title: Rate hike readjustment and AI hardware momentum: What to watch this week
title_zh: 加息调整和人工智能硬件动力：本周看点
summary: A quiet calendar ahead gives the market plenty of space to go off the beaten path this week as investors gear up for the beginning of earnings season.
summary_zh: 随着投资者为财报季的开始做好准备，本周平静的日历为市场提供了足够的空间来打破常规。
